title: Transport of the global-sections unit from the point unit
statement: For schemes X and Y, a morphism f:X→Y, a K-injective complex I, and an invertible right-derived unit for direct image along the global-sections point Y→(pt,Γ(Y,O_Y)), the right-derived global-sections unit at f_*I is invertible.

source.place: Tags 079W and 0D5T; exact equivalence of modules on the global-sections point, Tag 0B6A

proof.text: Obtain the equivalence of point module sheaves with global-ring modules from schemeDerivedGlobalSections_point_comparison [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. Its natural isomorphism with point global sections transfers preservation of finite limits and colimits; hence point evaluation is exact. Only this exactness evidence is used, not the existential derived comparison.

Construct the underived natural isomorphism p_* followed by point evaluation to global sections: on each module it is ModuleCat.restrictScalarsId, because toGlobalSectionsPoint has identity structure-sheaf map, and naturality follows by ModuleCat.hom_ext and reflexivity. For arbitrary additive F and exact G, use isRightDerivedFunctor_rightDerivedFunctor_comp_of_exact and rightDerivedDesc. The composite unit consists of the invertible G unit, the image of the assumed invertible F unit, and structural isomorphisms. Its descent comparison is an isomorphism by right-derived uniqueness; its factorization equation therefore makes the ordinary (F followed by G) unit invertible.

Transport invertibility from the composite functor to global sections along the underived natural isomorphism. Construct its homotopy-category natural isomorphism explicitly from the hom and inverse, and apply rightDerivedFunctorNatIso. The equation rightDerivedNatTrans_app identifies the F unit followed by the derived comparison with the underived comparison followed by the G unit. Cancel the invertible underived comparison to obtain invertibility of the desired global-sections unit at f_*I.

theorem globalSections_unit_isIso_of_point_unit
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wPt}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (globalSectionsPoint Y)))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (h : IsIso
      ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toGlobalSectionsPoint Y)).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
          (.up ℤ)).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I)))) :
    IsIso ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
          (.up ℤ)).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
